name: ClinicalSiteActivationTracker
tagline: Site start-up from feasibility to greenlight – stage gates, SLA due dates and an activation curve in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete clinical trial site start-up app for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: track CDA, feasibility, selection, budget and CTA, IRB/EC submission and approval, essential documents, SIV and a four-eyes greenlight for every site, see the activation curve against the study target and cycle times against SLAs, and act on at-risk sites from a pipeline board, a register or a milestone matrix.
features: Stage gates: CDA + feasibility → selection, CTA + valid IRB/EC approval → readiness, documents + SIV → greenlight
Feasibility score threshold with documented override
Essential-document checklist (central-IRB aware) that completes the milestone automatically
IRB/EC approval validity and continuing-review warnings
SLA due dates, overdue milestones, forecast greenlight and at-risk flags
Activation curve vs target, cycle time vs SLA, by-country table
Drag-and-drop pipeline, quick filters, grouping, bulk advance/assign/hold/export
Undo, hold/drop/resume with reasons, audit history
Demo mode with 36 fictional sites; phone layout with bottom view switcher
